=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5536-5585 (also scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:30-83; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2202-2203) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: judge_skip_reason=comments_context_incomplete has no arm in the Telegram case (default arm 5583-5584) or the comment script case (default arm 79-82), so it falls to the default CRITICAL "autofix exhausted / needs human intervention" alert and comment.
  WHY: The deferral is transient and self-healing, so each one produces a false human page and a misleading comment; both files are outside the issue's files_touched grant.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2165-2168, 2205-2208, 2916-2917 (also 2928-2937, 2955-2964) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The deferral gate only fires when RB_MERGE_ACTION=true, so a non-final `fix` verdict with incomplete comment context still pushes its fix commit.
  WHY: If auto-merge was enrolled in an earlier cycle, the push can lead to a merge, defeating "withhold every merge-enabling outcome". The sonnet reviewer disputed this in its notes: the push sets no merge, label or status, and the enrollment is a precondition the diff does not show.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1377-1392 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comments_incomplete check is gated on an empty RB_JUDGE_CONTEXT_EMPTY_REASON, so a failed helper run (nonzero exit) that still emits comments_incomplete: true never triggers the deferral.
  WHY: The judge may proceed on empty context instead of deferring. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR, minimax NIT (confidence 2). Sonnet and glm reviewed the same path and rejected it.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1387 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The `\A` and `\z` anchors in the `test("\\A[a-z_]{1,64}\\z")` reasons filter depend on the jq version's Oniguruma support.
  WHY: If unsupported, reasons fall back to `unspecified`; the deferral still fires and only the diagnostic text is affected.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2198-2201 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The deferral comment interpolates `${_rbci_action}` and `${RB_JUDGE_COMMENTS_INCOMPLETE_REASONS}` into `-f body="..."`.
  WHY: An unexpected token could corrupt the comment body; the `[a-z_]` filter and the fixed action set make this unlikely, and it matches the pattern at line 2184.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:PR head 23aef94 pre-push gate | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR body reports 6 test groups failing as caused by this change, yet none of them read files this diff touches, and the check-runs collection timed out.
  WHY: Either the attribution is wrong or the PR fails its own mandatory gate; the groups need re-running on the PR head.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Item 4: a test with a fake helper returning comments_incomplete: true and a merging verdict; check no merge command or ready-to-merge label is issued, the RB_JUDGE_CONTEXT_INCOMPLETE line is printed, and a complete context still merges as before.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_rb_judge_incomplete_comment_context.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The tests run the context block and the gate block separately with the flag injected via env, there is no end-to-end chain from helper to flag to gate to merge call, and test_complete_context_still_merges_as_before asserts only the FELLTHROUGH sentinel, not a real merge. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, the others NIT.
- requirement: "Withhold every merge-enabling outcome for this run: auto-merge enable, direct gh pr merge, the ai:ready-to-merge label and the success head-gate status."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh around the gate at line 2205 and the non-final-fix push block at lines 2916-2920
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The gate fires only for RB_MERGE_ACTION=true, so a non-final fix with a non-empty index reaches the `git push origin "HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH}"` at line 2917.
- requirement: The PR description reports 6 failures caused by this change.
  expected_change_site: not determinable from the diff
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: None of the named tests reads a file this diff touches; the failures need re-running on the PR head.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2202-2203 | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new skip reason has no handler in review_autofix.yml or the comment script, so it falls through to a default CRITICAL human-intervention page.
  WHY: Every deferred merge triggers a false-positive CRITICAL alert for a self-healing condition.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2928-2937, 2955-2964 | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The deferral gate checks only RB_MERGE_ACTION="true", so a non-final fix verdict that pushes judge changes bypasses it.
  WHY: If auto-merge was enrolled in an earlier cycle, the push can trigger a merge after the run, violating the withholding requirement.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1377 | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The incomplete-comments check is gated on RB_JUDGE_CONTEXT_EMPTY_REASON being empty.
  WHY: If context assembly fails, the flag logic is skipped and the judge may proceed on empty context instead of deferring.
- TASK_GAP: end-to-end test

  Expected change site: tests/test_rb_judge_incomplete_comment_context.py
  Evidence of absence: Existing tests inject the flag via env and exercise the context block and the gate block separately; no test verifies the full chain.
  severity=major | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
